```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

df <- read.table("/cloud/project/example.csv",
                 sep = ",", header = TRUE, comment.char = "#") |>
      mutate(across(2:5, ~ round(as.numeric(.), 1)))

kbl(df,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    caption = "Changes of air temperature.",
    linesep = "",  # 余計な横線を抑止
    align = "lrrrrr") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Range" = 4, " " = 1)) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") # 必要なら
```
